name: LibriTTS: Text-to-Speech Corpus
description: LibriTTS is a multi-speaker English speech corpus designed for text-to-speech (TTS) research. Derived from the original audio materials of LibriSpeech, it contains approximately 585 hours of 24kHz audio from 2,456 speakers with normalized text transcripts, sentence-level segmentation, and filtered background noise.
